title: 同伦意义下相容
summary: 单位与余单位只在同伦层面满足三角恒等

source.quote: pair of natural transformations µ ∶Id_{C} →G ○F and κ ∶F ○G →Id_{D} are compatible

definition: $\mu\colon\id_\cC\to GF$ 与 $\kappa\colon FG\to\id_\cD$ \textbf{同伦意义下相容}，指 $F\xrightarrow{\id_F\circ\mu}FGF\xrightarrow{\kappa\circ\id_F}F$ 同伦于 $\id_F$，且 $G\xrightarrow{\mu\circ\id_G}GFG\xrightarrow{\id_G\circ\kappa}G$ 同伦于 $\id_G$。
